'''joshbader Britney Spears and Watto''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[joshbader]]
* '''Published:''' 27 July 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 NMNPND joshbader DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Yep, shes done with Justin and this time shes dating outside her species. Watto’s gonna sit on the couch in her junkyard and yell at her till she brings in the beer. And if she speaks up slap her down and remind her whose slave she is.

== Strategy ==

Strategy

The start: Make sure and Mob Points at the very start before they can pull the Shield… grab Rendili. No Escape is in there to keep Honor from touching your objective and Ability, Ability, Ability. If you don’t start it, an early game Honor will kill you till you get it.  Your first objective is safely flipping your objective… if you can do it first turn safely do so. Just make sure that at the very least Watto is not alone in the junkyard. Feel free to deploy someone at Mos Espa to flip and then move over in your move phase. (After they lose 2 force… hehe)

Midgame: Keep to yourself and drain slowly at Mos Espa and Watto’s Junkyard… wait for your opponent  to either come down and attack you at one of them or go anyplace else… as soon as he’s at a battleground slap him silly and call him Britney. The deck wins mostly off of battle damage… The most common win is actually Zuckuss In Mist Hunter w/ Fett piloting and a 4LOM or IG-88 passenger. That’s seven power and four destiny for those of you keeping track at home. Just wait for your opponent to overstep to an area he can’t defend as well as he thinks he can. Make sure and use the grabber shield to take out either his Barriers or Path Of Least Resistence… either one will get incredibly annoying in the long run. (And QMC falls apart without Path anyways) Also watch for the Elis Helrot win… most people will give it to you more often than you realize because its been so long since the card has seen regular play.
